rationale: The original thesis remains intact as NBIS continues to trade below both the 5-minute 9-EMA ($101.92) and session VWAP ($102.67). After briefly testing $101.96 following entry, price rejected the 9-EMA and posted four consecutive lower 1-minute highs down to $100.27 before the current minor bounce to $101.50. With the invalidation level ($102.75) well defended above VWAP and price remaining in the lower third of today's range, the risk-to-reward profile favors holding for a breakdown below $100.00 toward the $97.00 target.
